name: Patchwork Collective Prodigy's Oversized Hand-Me-Down Set
description: An enormous adult-sized Halversen synth-wool sweater, three sizes too big, with the sleeves rolled up eight times and a crude BCI port cutout hacked into the neckline with scissors — the kid did it themselves. Beneath it, children's leggings in mismatched patterns and scuffed canvas shoes with the toes written on in permanent marker. A battered satchel worn crossbody is filled, visibly, with salvaged data chips and a cracked tablet.
functionality: Self-modified BCI port cutout allows direct neural interface access; oversized sweater provides warmth well beyond its intended use.
what_it_says: A child who is smarter than everyone around them and has no one making sure they eat.
manufacturer: Halversen (sweater, adult size); everything else scavenged
story_hooks: The data chips in the satchel contain something that multiple factions are currently looking for — the kid has no idea what they found.
The sweater belonged to a parent who hasn't come home in six weeks.
